notes.title: The Zombie Slayers – Demo Update Now Live!
notes.content:
We’ve rolled out a new update to The Zombie Slayers demo! Based on player feedback, we've made a number of changes to improve your experience.

The [b]Baby [/b]mechanic is now active in the demo! This tiny companion stays by your side, protects you, and occasionally demands milk with zero patience. Parenting meets survival !!!

🔧 Here’s what’s included:
[list]
[*]👶 [b]A baby added![/b] – [i]Yes, you read that right. A baby now follows and protects you loyally. But beware: when it gets tired, you'll need to feed it milk. No milk, no help.[/i]
[*]🎥 [b]Camera system updated[/b] – [i]The new camera is smoother and easier on the eyes. Prefer the old style? You can switch between both in the settings.[/i]
[*]🐞 [b]Bug fixes & better performance[/b] – [i]The game runs more fluidly thanks to core fixes.[/i]
[*]💬 [b]Improved onboarding[/b] – [i]New hints and clearer instructions help players get into the game more smoothly.[/i]
[*]🧍‍♂️🧑‍🤝‍🧑 [b]Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes separated[/b] – [i]More organized and streamlined mode selection.[/i]
[*]⚖️ [b]Gameplay rebalanced[/b] – [i]Combat and resource systems are now more fair and fun.[/i]
[*]🎮 [b]Usable items added[/b] – [i]You can now find and use new defensive and support gear to help you survive.[/i]
[*]🖥️ [b]UI polished[/b] – [i]Cleaner, sharper interface for a better overall experience.[/i]
[*]🎨 [b]Visual improvements[/b] – [i]Updated visuals add more atmosphere to the world.[/i]
[/list]

Try the updated demo now and let us know what you think! Don’t forget to Wishlist The Zombie Slayers and support the team.

💬 Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/UcGrfDssAN]Discord [/url]to share feedback, meet the community, and stay updated!

notes.title: The Zombie Slayers Demo is Live – Join the Fight !
notes.content:
Survivors, the time has come! [b]The Zombie Slayers[/b] has officially joined Steam Next Fest, and the demo is now live! Grab your weapons, face relentless zombie hordes, and prove that you have what it takes to survive the apocalypse.

⚔️ What’s waiting for you?

[list]
[*] Action-packed, chaotic zombie battles 💥
[*] A variety of fun and powerful weapons 🔫🔥
[*] Play solo or team up with friends for co-op madness!
[*] Unique maps full of surprises and challenges
[/list]

🧟‍♂️ The undead won’t stop coming, and it’s up to YOU to take them down! But beware—each wave is stronger than the last.

Your feedback is crucial! Tell us what you love, what scares you the most, and what could be even better. Let’s make The Zombie Slayers the ultimate zombie-slaying experience together!
And a huge shoutout to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]indie.io [/url]for teaming up with us—because let’s face it, teaming up with zombies to make an epic game is a partnership for the ages! 😜

🕒 Demo available: [i]Feb 24th at 10 AM PT – Mar 3rd at 10 AM PT[/i]
💾 Don’t forget to wishlist The Zombie Slayers on Steam and be ready for the full release!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/UcGrfDssAN]🔗 Join Discord[/url]

notes.title: indie.io - Official Publisher Announcement!
notes.content:
Dear The Zombie Slayers Community,

We are thrilled to share some exciting news with you today! We are proud to officially announce our partnership with indie.io This collaboration is a major step forward in bringing The Zombie Slayers to a wider audience and enhancing your gaming experience.

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From managing store pages to crafting marketing campaigns, and even ensuring the game shines at both digital and live events, indie.io provides support in all the areas where indie developers often face challenges alone.

indie.io is known for its expertise in supporting indie games and providing innovative solutions to independent developers. Through this partnership, we believe The Zombie Slayers will reach new heights and deliver even more amazing experiences to our player community.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]Check out the other amazing indie games being published by indie.io here![/url]
[url=https://www.wiki.gg/]Also Chek out Wiki.GG[/url]

We deeply value the support and feedback of our players, and we look forward to working together with you as we take The Zombie Slayers to the next level.

Stay tuned for upcoming updates, events, and exciting news by following our Steam page and social media channels.

Thank you for being a part of this journey!

Warm regards,
Rashad Ibrahimli
